election: Appointment as transitional president at the 'Conference for Announcing the Victory of the Syrian Revolution' (no popular vote)
role_sought: President of Syria for the transitional period
result: Appointed by the General Command of the armed factions; not an election
detail: Al-Sharaa has never stood in a popular election. He was named president by the commanders of the factions that overthrew Assad, an appointment confirmed by the Constitutional Declaration of 13 March 2025, which sets a five-year transition. The 2025–2026 People's Assembly was chosen indirectly (two-thirds by electoral colleges, one-third appointed by him), and no national election had been scheduled as of October 2026.
